entry.prompt: Low-poly game asset: a medieval storehouse for a top-down strategy game. A small square timber shed, open on the front, under a simple lean-to roof, filled with stacked wooden crates, barrels and grain sacks. A royal blue cloth awning along the open front.

style.suffix: Cream plaster walls, dark timber beams, grey stone base, grey-teal slate roof. Chunky low-poly shapes, hard edges, flat faces. Isolated building, no ground, no text, no characters.
style.texture: Stylized matte flat colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Walls: pale cream plaster (#EDE7D0). Timber: warm mid-brown wood (#8E765F). Stone: pale grey-beige blocks (#D4D4C4). Roof: muted grey-teal slate (#7E9597). Windows and doorways: dark blue-grey (#4D5F61). Banners and awnings: plain saturated royal blue cloth (#2B4FB0), no emblem. No dirt, moss, rust, text or logos.
